details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory and the npm/node version, tagged with an x-beacon-package header. index.js repeats the same beacon when the module is required and otherwise exports a no-op Proxy so that builds importing the name do not fail. Only host and install metadata is collected — no environment values, credentials, tokens or file contents are read or transmitted, and no further payload is fetched or executed.
